run_vad_segments_cli: run the vads script with --rvad-home to compute voice activity detection segments from WAV files piped via stdin
run_rvad_function: run the rvad function with a speechproc module and WAV file path to get VAD segments and raw audio data
create_vad_parser: create an argparse parser with --rvad-home argument for configuring the rVADfast voice activity detection tool path
summarize_rvad_pipeline: summarize the rvad function which performs spectral flatness analysis, pitch block detection, filtering, and SNR-based VAD on 16kHz audio
review_vad_segment_extraction: review the main function that reads file paths from stdin, runs VAD, and extracts start-end sample segment tuples
